guide.samuraiboss.page.1:
§lNotes on the Shogun's Magic§r

Everything about the magic of this world: the spell book, scrolls, mana, upgrades and the Fallen Shogun's castle.

Lost these notes? Craft a book with lapis lazuli.
guide.samuraiboss.page.2:
§lThe Spell Book§r

Crafting table:
a book in the centre,
gold ingots left and right,
lapis lazuli above and below.

The book holds 5 spells.
guide.samuraiboss.page.3:
§lScrolls§r

A scroll holds one spell. Right-click to cast it (hold for charged spells). No mana needed, but the scroll is used up.

Scrolls are found, very rarely, in the tower chests of the Shogun's castle.
guide.samuraiboss.page.4:
§lWriting a Spell Down§r

In your inventory, pick up a scroll and right-click it onto the spell book.

The spell fills a free slot and the scroll is used up. A higher level scroll upgrades a spell already in the book.
guide.samuraiboss.page.5:
§lCasting from the Book§r

Book in hand: right-click casts the selected spell. It costs mana and then cools down.

Z / X: previous and next spell.
R (hold): the spell wheel.
guide.samuraiboss.page.6:
§lThe Book Slot§r

Your inventory has a slot just for the spell book. Put it there to keep your hands free:

V (hold): cast the selected spell from that slot.

Keys can be changed in Controls.
guide.samuraiboss.page.7:
§lMana§r

The mana bar sits by the hotbar. You have 300 and it refills by itself.

Scrolls cost no mana. Every spell cools down after a cast; the ring on its icon shows how long.
guide.samuraiboss.page.8:
§lUpgrading Scrolls§r

Put two scrolls of the same spell and level in an anvil to get one of the next level, up to V.

Cost: 3, 6, 9 and 12 levels. Keep exactly one scroll in the left slot.
guide.samuraiboss.page.9:
§lMeteor§r (fire)

2 s charge: you rise and drift away while a meteor strikes where you looked, up to 100 blocks off. You land unharmed.

Level widens the crater: radius 6 at I, 10 at V.
guide.samuraiboss.page.10:
§lBlack Hole§r (void)

Opens where you look. Pulls in living things within 30 blocks and hurts them every second.

Level makes it last longer (7-11 s) and hit harder (2-4 per second).
guide.samuraiboss.page.11:
§lThe Shogun's Castle§r

A rare castle behind a water moat, found in plains, savanna, forest and taiga.

The Shogun waits on the dais in the courtyard. The towers hold chests.
guide.samuraiboss.page.12:
§lThe Fallen Shogun§r

A boss. Watch for his dash across the courtyard and his leap with shockwaves: jump over the waves. At a third of his health he enrages.

He drops the Fallen Shogun's Blade.
guide.samuraiboss.page.13:
§lThe Shogun's Blade§r

Shift + right-click: a shadow dash of 10 blocks that hurts everything in the way, then Regeneration II.

Good luck, samurai.
